text: Sell RGTI now — down 36.5% with revenue shrinking 34%, negative earnings, negative free cash flow, and 25% short interest, this is a broken position with no fundamental support to justify holding.
Sell SGLP.L — down nearly 15% with rock-bottom relative strength and a 99% drop from its 52-week high, this commodity holding's thesis has completely failed.
Trim IONQ to reduce your exposure — negative earnings, negative free cash flow, 20% short interest, and speculative quantum computing fundamentals make this too risky at current sizing.
Trim QBTS — down 21% with a 47% drop from highs, negative earnings, negative free cash flow, and 15.5% short interest all point to deteriorating risk/reward that warrants a smaller position.
Trim KTOS — down 24.5% and 55% from highs with an expensive PE of 54.5, high short interest, and no dividend, the risk here outweighs the defense sector appeal right now.

Add to MSFT on this pullback — a 14% decline in a company growing revenue at 15% with strong free cash flow is a rare opportunity to build a position in one of the highest-quality names in the market.
Add to NOW — ServiceNow is down 16.5% and 46% off highs, which is an oversized punishment for a company with strong growth, making this pullback an attractive entry point to increase your position.
